## Install Vinyl

1. Download **Vinyl-…dmg** from Assets below.
2. Open the disk image and drag **Vinyl → Applications**.
3. Eject the disk, open Vinyl from Applications, and look for the disc in your menu bar.

**macOS 14+ · Apple Silicon and Intel.** Desktop playback supports Yandex Music, Spotify, and Apple Music when they publish macOS Now Playing data. Chrome/Edge browser integration needs separate setup; see the README.

This development build is ad-hoc signed, **not Apple-notarized**. See [Apple’s opening instructions](https://support.apple.com/102445) if macOS blocks a copy you trust. Never disable Gatekeeper globally.

The adjacent `.sha256` file lets you verify download integrity. It is not an independent signature or a replacement for notarization.
